answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to verified work history. A new identity must lock a bond and complete real, peer-attested tasks before it gains full earning or voting weight, so influence grows with useful work, not with the number of accounts. If an identity copies work or attests falsely, its bond is slashed and its history marked. An attacker must therefore fund a bond and do real work for every fake identity, like tending a separate meadow, planting a separate willow, and carving a separate ivory token for each one. That makes mass creation costly and slow.
